user_assistance_required: Provide or approve NAS Docker image/version parity evidence before any deploy: current image tag, target image tag, and rollback tag.
Provide external admin-worker environment proof from the NAS host or exported Docker inspect/.env output.
Run or allow the Windows Cutter compatibility smoke only after a staged Docker release candidate exists.
Do not provide credentials as a workaround for missing API routes; first point NAS Docker at an image exposing the current Admin API contract.
decision.summary: The targeted live-readonly artifact does not expose the full current Admin Architecture v1 API, version_health_parity contract, admin_worker_env_proof contract, and cutter_compatibility_proof contract, so an image/API parity update is required later. Deployment remains blocked until release gates and external proofs pass.

gates.title: Parity plan has no deploy side effects
gates.evidence: This report reads an archived live-readonly artifact only; it does not contact NAS Docker, build images, push images, restart containers, or write NAS files.

gates.title: Live artifact was collected from an explicit target
gates.evidence: Target artifact is explicit and probe-safe: http://192.168.1.27:18080 (admin-web-url).
gates.required_evidence: Run MIXLAB_ADMIN_DOCKER_LIVE_BASE_URL=<target> npm run validate:admin-docker-release-live-readonly before parity planning.

gates.title: Admin Web root observed
gates.required_evidence: Admin Web root must be reachable before comparing API/image parity.

gates.title: Admin API proxy observed
gates.evidence: auth=HTTP 404, not_found 路由不存在, 12.1ms; library=HTTP 200, ok, 830.7ms; supervisor=HTTP 200, ok, 6.4ms
gates.required_evidence: At least one Admin API JSON endpoint must respond through Admin Web before diagnosing image/API parity.

gates.title: Current Admin API contract parity
gates.required_evidence: Deploy or stage an Admin image exposing /api/admin/auth/status, /api/admin/release-gates, and /api/admin/data-loading/plan, then rerun the GET-only live-readonly probe.

gates.title: Version/health parity contract
gates.evidence: The archived live-readonly artifact does not include a complete version_health_parity contract.
gates.required_evidence: Deploy or stage an Admin image exposing version_health_parity from /api/admin/release-gates, then rerun the GET-only live-readonly probe.

gates.title: admin-worker env proof contract
gates.evidence: The archived live-readonly artifact does not include a complete admin_worker_env_proof contract.
gates.required_evidence: Deploy or stage an Admin image exposing admin_worker_env_proof from /api/admin/release-gates, then rerun the GET-only live-readonly probe.

gates.title: Cutter compatibility proof contract
gates.evidence: The archived live-readonly artifact does not include a complete cutter_compatibility_proof contract.
gates.required_evidence: Deploy or stage an Admin image exposing cutter_compatibility_proof from /api/admin/release-gates, then rerun the GET-only live-readonly probe.

gates.title: Docker library root parity
gates.required_evidence: NAS Docker Admin must report /data/PublicLibrary before any release update is allowed.

gates.title: NAS disk risk remains gated
gates.required_evidence: Free space or prove write-block behavior with live release gates before enabling preprocessing in Docker.

gates.title: Running admin-worker environment proof
gates.evidence: The live-readonly Admin API artifact cannot inspect the running admin-worker container environment.
gates.required_evidence: Capture target Docker .env and running admin-worker environment showing standalone workers remain disabled unless explicitly opted in.

gates.title: Cutter compatibility proof after staged candidate
gates.evidence: A Docker Admin parity plan cannot prove Windows Cutter still reads the release/index/search protocol.
gates.required_evidence: Run and archive Cutter compatibility smoke after a separately gated Docker release candidate is staged.

result.summary: This parity plan never approves Docker upload; it only identifies whether an image/API parity update is needed and what proof is missing.
